newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Mega Pascal shares debut at 7.40 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Mega Pascal shares debut at 7.40 rgt.

text.p: Shares of Malaysia's Mega Pascal Bhd made their market debut at 7.40 ringgit against an offer price of 3.50 ringgit.
The maker of ready-mixed concrete offered 3.3 million new shares and 4.207 million vendor shares for its listing on the Second Board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
Around eight minutes into the opening, the stock was at 7.70 ringgit on volume of 1.2 million shares traded, after trading between 7.40 and 7.75 ringgit,
Mega Pascal reported net profit of 7.46 million ringgit and earnings per share (EPS) of 46.9 cents for the the year ended December 31, 1995, on turnover of 119.21 million.
For 1996, it had estimated net profit of 7.0 million ringgit and EPS of 44.0 cents, and for 1997, net earnings of 8.32 million and EPS of 31.9 cents.
